defects.summary: A read that crosses the authored read-volume threshold in report mode records its READ_VOLUME_GATE report decision, then the same call records its ordinary allow decision under the same tool_call_id. The register replaces by tool_call_id, so the report never reaches the audit row: the one artifact report mode exists to leave is overwritten in the same call. Plan: PR C fixes it, as its one named allowed change.

When the matter gate, the multi-matter fence, the structure floor, the content floor, the voice gate or the spec gate blocks a call the ceiling allowed, the wall returns a block after recording allowed=true for that tool_call_id and does not record again, so the decision register holds an allow for a call that was refused. A refused call never reaches post_tool_call, so no audit row is written from it today; the register's per-thread last slot still holds the allow. Recorded for the split to keep exactly; not yet shown to reach a row.
where: plugins/hermes-smd-trust/enforce.py:1910 and :1940 (the matter blocks, returned without a record)

defects.summary: A fault after the reply's bytes reached the transport and before _commit_reply completes is swallowed by the relay's catch-all with no REPLY_SENT row, no REPLY_FAILED row, no notice and no page (the catch-all skips a transmitted reply), and the email's id is left uncommitted in _REPLIED, so a second draft in the same turn would be relayed again. Seen by injecting a raise at each call after the send.
